_doc: Generic gathering-failed events of recreation activities, fired from code (Job_Activity) - no trigger of their own. An activity picks one with gatherFailedEventID (RecreationActivity / RecreationOfferDef; "" = Recreation_GatherFailed_Stay) - or names its own. Fired once when the gathering fails at T+30 (no NPC participant there, or a mandatory participant missing), and again for each latecomer reaching the gather room afterwards (isLate). The consequences are this event's own Results. SELF ONLY DECIDES VISIBILITY (the player when involved, forced on screen) - use the targets: participants / mandatory / optional / host / <role IDs> / waited (in the gather room at the failure) / late (the original fire: who was still missing; a late fire: the latecomer) / player. AppendStrings: isLate (late fire only), hasWaited / hasLate (when those targets are non-empty), activityFailed, activityName.

list._comment: No consequence: the bookings stay, so everyone sandboxes the venue alone until the visit is over (the job never pulls them in again).

Those who waited give up and leave: their bookings are cancelled (CancelRecreationBooking on waited, the booking in effect now) - their behavior tree sends them home. A latecomer's booking is cancelled the same way (CancelRecreationBooking on late).

Generic begin event of a media activity (RecreationActivity.requireMedia - a movie / game session): fired by Job_Activity at the launch, it starts the session (LaunchJob Job_MediaSession, participants = those in the room - its instanceKey AppendString links the job to the activity; the job then runs for the item's runtime and fires the item's own start / end events). A late arrival's fire (isLate) only notes them joining - never a second LaunchJob (the job refuses one anyway). AppendStrings used: activityName, mediaName.

Begin event of a SILENT launch (launchEventID "") of a trustRewardEligible activity, fired only when there is a trust reward to pay (2+ keptPromise - Job_Activity.StartBeginEvent): the job pays the Trust into this event's message log before it starts, the FlushMessageExpAll shows it. Same targets / AppendStrings as a begin event, plus keptPromise / hasKeptPromise. Not replayed for late arrivals (the activity's launchEventID stays ""). Every custom begin event of a trustRewardEligible activity must likewise FlushMessageExpAll on its initial-launch path.

Generic end event of a launched activity that ran its course (RecreationActivity.endEventID "" - Job_Activity.EndJob; never after a failed gathering or a cancellation). Only notes the end; a custom endEventID may replace it to add activity-specific relationship bonuses (the trust reward is paid by the job at the launch either way). SELF ONLY DECIDES VISIBILITY. Targets: tookPart (at the launch or joining late), keptPromise (agreed beforehand + on time - the trust reward's group, hasKeptPromise when set), plus the outcome events' participants / mandatory / optional / host / <role IDs> / waited / late / player. AppendStrings: activityEnded, activityName, playerInvite, activityTrustEligible, mediaName.

Fired from code (Job_Activity.RequestWalkIn), no trigger, the player only: they clicked an ongoing activity package (activity: ...) of an activity they are not part of. Self = the player; Targets.companions = who is at that package; AppendStrings activityName / command (the package's command) / feeText (the entrance fee line, empty when free; hasFee set when there is one). The join option runs the 'join' callback: the player is registered in that package's group (the activity's begin event plays as the join, the fee is charged) and joins the package. Asked only while the player is not part of the activity.

zh-cn.Recreation_GatherFailed_nobody: 约定的时间已经过了半个小时，却没有人来参加$activityName$，只好取消了。
zh-cn.Recreation_GatherFailed_Stay_waited: $waited.name$等了半个小时，$late.name$还是没有来，$activityName$只好取消了。
zh-cn.Recreation_GatherFailed_Leave_waited: $waited.name$等了半个小时，$late.name$还是没有来，只好先离开了。
zh-cn.Recreation_GatherFailed_Leave_late: $late.name$赶到时已经太晚了，$activityName$早已取消，等待的人也都离开了。
